I'm not sure saying that they keys "are" the content attributes works well. The keys are the names of the content attributes; the values are the values.

The most rigorous way to define this would be with some kind of "set the content attribute" / "get the content attribute" / "delete the content attribute" definition, which had one definition for ElementInternals and one definition for elements.
